rca of the issue: Repro: run pytest /app/backend/tests/execution_spine -k test_execution_descriptor_builders_with_real_models_and_hash_ref_guards. tr1(training_request with corpus_manifest_ref=.../manifest-a) and tr3(...manifest-b) produce identical objective_sha256.
